section: Public distribution, procurement and buffer-stocking; food subsidy and FCI reform
subsections: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s: The Food Corporation of India was set up on which date?
accepted.x: The Food Corporation of India was established on 14 January 1965.
accepted.tq: Use the precise day and year to distinguish the establishment date from the governing Act and digital-system dates.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s: The Food Corporation of India was established under which Act on the recommendation of which committee?
o: Food Corporations Act, 1964; Food Grains Prices Committee chaired by L. K. Jha
Essential Commodities Act, 1955; Agricultural Prices Commission
Agricultural Produce Markets Act; Kelkar Committee
accepted.x: FCI was set up under the Food Corporations Act, 1964, on the recommendation of the Food Grains Prices Committee associated with L. K. Jha in 1964.
accepted.tq: Match the statutory basis with the recommending committee instead of confusing the Food Corporations Act with other agriculture and food laws.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s: The headquarters of the Food Corporation of India is located at
accepted.x: The headquarters of the Food Corporation of India is in New Delhi.
accepted.tq: Test the institutional location directly and distinguish the FCI headquarters from the location of IGMRI.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s: With reference to the procurement role of the Food Corporation of India, which one of the following is correct?
o: It regulates agricultural markets under State APMC laws.
It distributes foodgrains without the participation of State agencies.
It is the nodal agency for procuring wheat and paddy under price support.
It procures only oilseeds and pulses under price support.
accepted.x: FCI is the nodal agency for procuring wheat and paddy under price support, with State agencies functioning alongside it. Regulation of agricultural markets is associated with State APMC laws.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise institutional responsibility and reject options that expand or wrongly transfer the agency’s role.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the missions of the Food Corporation of India:
1. Efficient procurement of foodgrains at MSP.
2. Storage, movement and distribution of foodgrains.
3. Maintaining operational and buffer stocks for food security.
4. Making foodgrains accessible at reasonable prices to weaker sections through TPDS.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements describe the missions of FCI: procurement at MSP, storage and distribution, maintenance of operational and buffer stocks, and access to foodgrains through TPDS.
accepted.tq: Check whether each statement belongs to the agency’s stated mission before selecting the complete combination.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s: The Online Storage Management system of the Food Corporation of India was rolled out from
accepted.x: OSM was rolled out from 1 April 2022.
accepted.tq: Separate the rollout date of OSM from the establishment year of FCI and the date of the governing Act.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s: The principal purpose of the Online Storage Management (OSM) system is to facilitate
o: efficient storage, movement and distribution under TPDS
international trade in foodgrains through the WTO
regulation of agricultural markets by State governments
direct cash transfers to farmers under MSP
accepted.x: OSM was introduced for efficient storage, movement and distribution of foodgrains under the Targeted Public Distribution System.
accepted.tq: Link the digital tool to the operational stage it manages—storage, movement and distribution under TPDS.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes Anna Darpan?
o: An agricultural market-regulation law administered by State APMCs
A foodgrain price committee chaired by L. K. Jha
An integrated supply-chain management system of FCI
A buffer-stock accounting system of the WTO
accepted.x: Anna Darpan is FCI’s integrated supply-chain management system, intended to modernise its supply chain. It belongs to the food and PDS side, not to the Agriculture Ministry.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between a digital FCI supply-chain system and institutions or laws dealing with agricultural markets and trade.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s:
With reference to Anna Darpan, consider the following statements:
1. It is associated with the food and PDS side of administration.
2. It is a system belonging to the Agriculture Ministry.
3. It is intended to modernise the supply chain of FCI.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Anna Darpan is associated with the food and PDS side and modernises FCI’s supply chain; it does not belong to the Agriculture Ministry.
accepted.tq: Spot the wrong-ministry trap while retaining the two statements that identify the system’s sector and purpose.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s: Which digital system provides end-to-end tracking of foodgrain from procurement to the Fair Price Shop, together with real-time stock monitoring to check leakage?
accepted.x: SARTHAK-PDS digitally tracks grain from procurement to the Fair Price Shop and monitors stocks in real time to help prevent leakage.
accepted.tq: Trace the system’s coverage from procurement to the FPS and use its anti-leakage function as the identifying clue.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s: The Indian Grain Storage Management and Research Institute, associated with foodgrain storage research and training, is situated at
accepted.x: The Indian Grain Storage Management and Research Institute is located at Hapur.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the research institute’s location from the headquarters of FCI and the names of persons associated with the recommending committee.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)

accepted.s:
Which of the following are identified as challenges faced by the Food Corporation of India?
1. Rising operating costs
2. Excess stocks and wastage
3. Falling issue-price earnings
4. Regulation of agricultural markets by FCI
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Rising operating costs, excess stocks and wastage, and falling issue-price earnings are identified challenges of FCI. Regulation of agricultural markets is not an FCI function or challenge described here; it falls under State APMC laws.
accepted.tq: Separate genuine operational and financial challenges from a wrongly assigned institutional responsibility.
accepted.sec: FCI - year set up, Act, recommending committee, missions and functions, digital systems (OSM, Anna Darpan)
